note: UN view of disputed areas, applied to Natural Earth's disputed-area polygons (data/geopolitics/pov.json). Where UN resolutions affirm a state's territorial integrity, the area is drawn as part of that state; where the UN takes no position or the status is unresolved, the area is drawn as disputed. Areas not listed keep Natural Earth's de facto assignment. Rules apply in order; 'owners' means every listed code appears among the area's owners in some country's view.
